replay: Same stable identity, observation and base_version replay without another lifecycle event. Changed observation payload refuses.
terminal_policy: Refuse new source actions and recapture. Exclude from routing, summaries, active proposals, sender outbox and Home email cards. Retain historical records with lifecycle metadata.
prior_actions: Record proposal IDs, prior statuses and source event IDs as permanent action_notes in captured context and lifecycle audit events. Preserve subsequent human changes.
restoration: Unsupported. Movement retains stable identity and does not tombstone a message.
tenant: Server-derived carr-internal. Caller tenant selection is forbidden; mailbox owner must match authenticated partner authority and account must match the immutable captured identity.
